title: Colosseum 1.1.8
summary: Connect your Trakt, SIMKL or MyAnimeList account directly, without a Stremio account.

highlights.title: Connect directly
highlights.body: Connect your Trakt, SIMKL or MyAnimeList account directly, without a Stremio account.

highlights.title: Sign in your way
highlights.body: Trakt and SIMKL use device codes. MyAnimeList opens in the app, with an external-browser fallback.

highlights.title: Catalogue row index
highlights.body: Browse add-on catalogue rows from the Discover sidebar and shared row sidebars.

highlights.title: Scroll, glass and keyboard flow
highlights.body: Smoother scrolling, clearer focus, improved glass surfaces and a docked tab bar.

highlights.title: Set up inside Colosseum
highlights.body: Configure supported add-ons inside the app.

highlights.title: Chapter Mode when needed
highlights.body: Series without volume data open in Chapter Mode.
